findings.description: storage_encrypted = false is explicitly set, leaving the RDS instance's data, automated backups and snapshots unencrypted at rest, so anyone with storage or snapshot access can read the database contents.

publicly_accessible = true assigns the MySQL instance a publicly resolvable endpoint, removing the network boundary and exposing the database listener to the internet independent of security group rules.

The RDS master password (var.password) is interpolated into the EC2 user_data script and written to /var/www/inc/dbinfo.inc. User data is retrievable via the instance metadata service and the file sits on the web root, exposing the DB admin credential to anyone who can reach the instance or IMDS.
The master password is supplied as a plaintext argument (password = var.password) with no secrets manager integration and is persisted in Terraform state and plan files in cleartext.

The role assumed by the app server grants s3:*, ec2:* and rds:* on Resource "*", giving full administrative control over three services including reading all S3 data and reconfiguring or deleting the RDS database. Combined with the internet-reachable web instance this is a direct path from web compromise to full account data access.

The bootstrap script embeds the DB endpoint, admin username, password and database name in cleartext in user_data and stores them in /var/www/inc/dbinfo.inc, which is reachable from the web root hierarchy and readable via instance metadata.

MySQL 3306 ingress is allowed from the entire portal_vpc CIDR rather than from the application security group specifically, so any resource in the VPC — including the public-facing web instance or any future workload — can reach the database. Segmentation to the application tier is absent.

The database security group permits all protocols and all ports to 0.0.0.0/0, allowing outbound traffic to any destination including the internet, which facilitates data exfiltration and command-and-control callbacks from a compromised database host.

findings.issue_category: TLS not enforced on database connections
findings.description: No setting enforces encrypted connections (no require_secure_transport in the parameter group, no rds.force_ssl), and the application connects with plain mysqli_connect without TLS, so DB credentials and query data traverse the network in cleartext.
